title: Eurystheus
summary: Eurystheus is dated in Raleigh's chronological table (1617), column Argos, by a yeere of the World. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person.
description: Added from the Raleigh import (The History of the World, 1617). Raleigh is display-only. He gives a yeere of the World, not a BC year, and no tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: Calculated from printed figures. No tier 1–4 birth, no tier reign start, and no provisional year. Raleigh prints the yeere of the World 2720. Creation is 4032 BC (Kevin, 2026-10-28). BC = 4033 − AM, so AM 2720 = 1313 BC. The figure is not written into year_bc_ad. A printed year for this person would replace it.

calculated.citation: Raleigh, The History of the World (1617, EEBO-TCP A10357), Chronological Table, sig. 785b
calculated.arithmetic: Raleigh prints the yeere of the World 2720. Creation is 4032 BC (Kevin, 2026-10-28). BC = 4033 − AM, so AM 2720 = 1313 BC. The figure is not written into year_bc_ad.

reign.citation: Raleigh, The History of the World (1617, EEBO-TCP A10357), Chronological Table, sig. 785b
reign.note: Year cell "3402 2720 207". The third printed figure 207 is the column "Exodus", not a length. To the Reader (sig. 780b): the Julian Period exceeds the yeere of the World by 682. The 45 at the end of the name is the reign length he prints. The end year is not printed on this row.
